mapper.select: select wifi_id, campus_name, ssid, bssid, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from edu_wifi_config where wifi_id = #{wifiId}
mapper.insert: insert into edu_wifi_config (campus_name, ssid, bssid, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{campusName}, #{ssid}, #{bssid}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark})
